name: quantflow-pro
description: QuantFlow Pro monorepo — verification entrypoint. Each workspace keeps its own toolchain; this root only orchestrates checks.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix quantflow-modules/flow-engine install && npm --prefix quantflow-modules/firecrawl install
scripts.verify: npm run verify:backend && npm run verify:modules && npm run verify:frontend
scripts.verify:backend: npm run verify:backend:types && npm run verify:backend:test && npm run verify:backend:build
scripts.verify:frontend: npm run verify:frontend:env && npm run verify:frontend:types && npm run verify:frontend:test && npm run verify:frontend:build
scripts.verify:frontend:env: node -e "const m=['NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL','NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY'].filter(k=>!(process.env[k]||'').trim()); if(m.length){console.error('[verify] frontend build requires: '+m.join(', ')+'\n[verify] These are public (non-secret) values baked in at build time; /login and /register prerender fails without them.'); process.exit(1);}"
scripts.verify:modules: npm run verify:flow-engine && npm run verify:firecrawl
scripts.verify:flow-engine: npm --prefix quantflow-modules/flow-engine run typecheck && npm --prefix quantflow-modules/flow-engine test
scripts.verify:ml: python3 -m compileall -q ml-service && cd ml-service && python3 -m pytest test_ml_gates.py -q
scripts.audit:all: npm --prefix backend audit --audit-level=high; npm --prefix frontend audit --audit-level=high
